name: Ashbourne Vertical Slice
description: Manifest describing the vertical slice package, assets, scripts, and build entry points.

assets.notes: Renderer's default character mesh, generated by scripts/generate_placeholder_mesh.py

notes: Paths here are relative to the repo root. This file replaces the older docs/vertical_slice/manifest.json, which predates the flattening of the vertical_slice/ subfolder into the repo root and pointed at paths that no longer exist. The asset pipeline (export -> import -> metadata) now runs automatically as part of the CMake build via the asset_pipeline target; running the scripts manually is only needed for the standalone packaging flow in build_vertical_slice.sh.
